gui.jeict.recipe_tree.title: JEI Recipe Tree
gui.jeict.recipe_tree.overview_hint: Scroll to zoom; Shift + scroll horizontally; drag to pan; left-click to choose a child recipe; right-click for node details
gui.jeict.recipe_tree.overview_required_: Required patterns: not calculated (quantity compute off)
gui.jeict.recipe_tree.overview_quantity_:
When on: show rolled-up amounts and required-pattern count; external backends may also mark materials that already have patterns.
When off: skip those calculations to reduce lag.
gui.jeict.recipe_tree.me_pattern_exists_: ME network already has a pattern for this
gui.jeict.recipe_tree.overview_toggle_ex: Expansion for patterns already in the ME network is disabled
Expansion for patterns already in the ME network is enabled
Controls whether branches with patterns already present in the ME network continue expanding.
gui.jeict.recipe_tree.overview_style_too: Cycle through the AE2 terminal style, the classic blueprint style and the dark style.
gui.jeict.recipe_tree.overview_encode_to: Encode recipes missing from the network across all trees in the workspace
gui.jeict.recipe_tree.overview_upload_to: Upload patterns from all trees in the workspace (requires an external backend)
gui.jeict.recipe_tree.overview_auto_uniq: When enabled, unresolved branches that have exactly one usable JEI recipe expand automatically.
gui.jeict.recipe_tree.overview_merge_too: Merge same-material branches per layer; hold Ctrl + scroll to zoom in merged view
gui.jeict.recipe_tree.overview_substitut: Bulk encode: substitution behavior is provided by the external backend.
gui.jeict.recipe_tree.material_right_cli: Left-click: choose child recipe, right-click: jump to this material
gui.jeict.recipe_tree.floating_show_all_: Show materials already available in inventory
gui.jeict.recipe_tree.floating_scale_too: Ctrl+scroll to scale the entire panel (%s%%); double-click the title to reset
gui.jeict.recipe_tree.floating_auto_craf: Auto-craft: fill the open container with the first recipe it accepts
message.jeict.auto_craft_started: Continuous auto-crafting started. Click Craft again to stop.
message.jeict.auto_craft_no_container: Open a machine or crafting interface first.
message.jeict.auto_craft_no_handler: This interface does not accept any recipe from the tree.
message.jeict.auto_craft_missing_items: Not enough materials for any recipe in the tree.
message.jeict.auto_craft_rejected: This interface rejected the selected recipe.
message.jeict.auto_craft_failed: Recipe transfer failed; check the current interface state.
gui.jeict.recipe_tree.pin_materials_tool: Pin total materials to the floating panel
message.jeict.recipe_tree_existing_patte: This material already has a pattern, so further expansion is disabled.
message.jeict.recipe_tree_select_target_: Left-click + in the recipe tree first to choose the target branch.
message.jeict.recipe_tree_recursive_reci: Cannot select a recipe that would create a recursion loop.
message.jeict.recipe_tree_opened_jei: Opened the JEI recipe list. Click + to choose this child recipe.
gui.jeict.recipe_tree.inspector_action_h: Left-click a node to choose its child recipe; right-click to open node details
gui.jeict.recipe_tree.pattern_preview_em: Choose a child recipe to preview encoded slots
gui.jeict.recipe_tree.overview_memory_re: When enabled, saved recipe choices are restored from the global config and expanded automatically. Branches manually collapsed on this screen stay collapsed.
gui.jeict.recipe_tree.batch_tooltip: Scroll to adjust batches; hold Shift to change by 10
gui.jeict.recipe_tree.overview_strategy_: Choose how alternative ingredients are allocated by the global planner.
gui.jeict.recipe_tree.projects_tooltip: Manage multiple crafting targets and quantities
gui.jeict.recipe_tree.plan_tooltip: Open the global materials, machines, and routes report
gui.jeict.recipe_tree.cycle_warning: This material recipe returns to an upstream node; expansion stopped to prevent a cycle.
gui.jeict.recipe_tree.pattern_invalid: Invalid pattern: at least one input and a primary output are required
gui.jeict.recipe_tree.pattern_modified: Modified; batch encode and upload will use this draft
gui.jeict.recipe_tree.pattern_ready: Matches the source recipe and is ready to encode
gui.jeict.recipe_tree.pattern_cycle_alte: Left-click to cycle recipe alternatives for this slot
gui.jeict.recipe_tree.pattern_slot_contr: Left-click to select/use held item; right-click to clear; middle-click to edit amount; Ctrl+wheel adjusts amount
gui.jeict.recipe_tree.pattern_item_subst: Toggle item substitutions for this pattern
gui.jeict.recipe_tree.pattern_fluid_subs: Toggle fluid substitutions for this pattern
gui.jeict.recipe_tree.pattern_reset_tool: Restore the default pattern generated from the JEI recipe
gui.jeict.recipe_tree.pattern_scroll: Scroll input and output slot pages
message.jeict.recipe_tree_pattern_invali: Pattern “%s” is invalid; batch encode/upload was cancelled.
gui.jeict.recipe_tree.pattern_input_remo: Warning: a source input was removed; the machine may lack materials
gui.jeict.recipe_tree.pattern_output_rem: A byproduct was excluded from AE2; the machine may still produce it
gui.jeict.recipe_tree.pattern_primary_ch: Warning: the primary output changed and may not match the tree target
gui.jeict.recipe_tree.jei_preview_unavai: The matching JEI recipe preview is unavailable
gui.jeict.recipe_tree.jei_shortcut_open_: Open the most recently used recipe-tree workspace
gui.jeict.recipe_tree.jei_shortcut_add_t: Open JEI and choose a recipe to create the first tree
gui.jeict.recipe_tree.workspace_click_to: Click this recipe tree to edit it in the current screen
message.jeict.recipe_tree_jei_unavailabl: JEI is not ready; unable to choose a recipe tree.
